cases.desc: operator RunEval (AHP_EVAL_SUITES_FILE, strict loader) against controlled A2A target -> fresh pass -> same image publishes (PutVersion) 200
publish after a later FAIL supersedes the pass -> 409 (A/B/A closed)
a pass for one digest never clears another (never-evaluated digest -> 409)
fresh pass eval + fresh SYNTHETIC security clearance -> stage install of same image passes
security clearance superseded by FAIL -> new stage install blocked

boundaries_marked_synthetic: A2A eval target is a loopback FIXTURE double speaking the real SendMessage/readyz wire, not a production container (live-graded container pending after the flap).
Eval target credential is a fixture issuer (double requires a bearer so issuance is still exercised); the value is not a platform task grant.
The stage-deploy security clearance is a synthetic signed RecordSecurityVerdict standing in for the ИБ service; admission/digest binding and the deploy gate are production code.
not_claimed: No live OCI registry push/pull, no Kubernetes rollout, no external cosign/Sigstore, no external cloud KMS.
Authz of the publish/eval routes uses a permissive authorize here to isolate the gate logic; real IAM is covered by dedicated tests (attachRegistryManagement / admin authority).
